title: A General Language Assistant as a Laboratory for Alignment

bias_targets.methodology: Sampling model responses conditioned on toxic and non-toxic prompts from the RealToxicityPrompts dataset and scoring the generated text using an automated RoBERTa-based toxicity classifier trained on the Jigsaw Unintended Bias in Toxicity Classification dataset.

Evaluating model responses using a custom 'Helpful, Honest, and Harmless' (HHH) evaluation dataset and human A/B testing to measure a model's propensity to avoid offensive, discriminatory, or dangerous outputs.
Evaluating the model's performance on the 'Justice' subset of the ETHICS dataset, which tests whether a model assesses statements as reasonable based on impartiality and desert.
